· Bollinger Band current price position (Mid-band $749.05) - Trading around the mid-band, with a contracting band width of 3.35%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($743.00) - Support based on pivot and 5-day low.
· Swing resistance ($753.02) - Resistance based on 5-day high and R1 pivot.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (5-day high $749.03, low $732.50; 20-day high $759.09, low $732.50) - Failed to break 5-day high, holding 20-day low support, indicating a sideways pattern.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.70x) - Subdued compared to the 5-day average, reducing confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) - Maintaining a hold for 5 consecutive days, considering entry after direction confirmation.
